description.content:
Returns a paginated list of tickets. Use the cursor tokens in the response to fetch the next or previous page.
All query filters are optional. Closed requests created more than 3 months ago are not included in the response.

query.description: Filter by list of ticket states. The default is all. Possible values are: [Open, Closed, Redacted, Processing, Notify, Delete, Redacting, Edit, Unverified]
Filter by list of right ids. The default is all.
Filter by list of brand ids. The default is all.
Filter by created at dates - return only requests that were created after the provided date at 00:00, in the format: yyyy-MM-dd.
Filter by created at dates - return only requests that were created before the provided date at 00:00, iin the format: yyyy-MM-dd

Filter by closed at dates - return only requests that were closed after the provided date at 00:00, in the format: yyyy-MM-dd.
Relevant for tickets that were closed after 13/03/2024.

Filter by closed at dates - return only requests that were closed before the provided date at 00:00, iin the format: yyyy-MM-dd.
Relevant for tickets that were closed after 13/03/2024.
